Name:
Jumping Jack Toe Touch
(JJTT)
Description: Jumping Jack followed immediately by bending at the waist and touching toes.

Name: 21 Guns
Description: 7 reps bicep curls to the halfway point then 7 reps from the halfway point to chest, then 7 full bicep curls.

Name: 7 of Diamonds
Description: PAX travel around a diamond (baseball field type set up) doing 7 reps of one exercise at each base/cone. PAX do 14 reps of a different exercise the second time around the diamond, 21 reps the third time, 28 reps the fourth time, 21 reps the fifth time, 14 reps the sixth time, and back to 7 reps the seventh time around.

Name: A GRAND Beatdown
Description:
Q chooses anywhere from 10-30 exercises and assigns them dollar amounts based on difficulty.  Ex: 25 Curls = $25, 10 Burpees = $50, or Running a Lap = $100.  Choose $25/50/100 to make totaling easier.  The PAX take turns "spending" by choosing their exercise until they've "spent" $1000.  Exercises can be repeated if desired.
(Note: I used pennies to track the total - 1 penny = $25)

Name: ABC Abs
Description: In a leg lift position, write the letters of the alphabet with your legs. Capital or lower-case - you choose.

Name: Ab-O-Rama
Description: PAX calls out an ab exercise for everyone to do, then move on to the next pax who picks a different ab exercise to do, and so forth.

Name: Ab-solution
Description: Starting position: Plank on hands.  1) Drop down to plank on elbows, 2) Plank jack, 3) Raise up to plank on hands, then 4) Tuck jump legs in and back out.

Name: Accumulator
Description: Sometimes called an Accelerator. An accumulation of reps for two exercises completed back to back. Example: Push Ups and Shoulder Taps. Do 1 Push Up, followed by 2 Shoulder Taps, then 2 Push Ups followed by 4 Shoulder Taps. Then 3 Push Ups followed by 6 Shoulder Taps...all the way to 10 and 20. We like to do Squats and Monkey Humpers, Crunchy Frogs and LBCs as well.

Name: Achin Legs
Description: 20 Squats, 20 Step Ups (or box jumps), 20 Lunges, 20 Jump Lunges. Rinse and repeat as many times as you desire.

Name: Aircraft Marshall
Description: 2 Hammer Curls + 2 Shoulder Press

Name: ALARM
Description: A-L-A-R-M Arm, Leg, Ab, Run, M Exercise (Example: Shoulder Press, Lunge, LBC, Run, Merkin)

Name: Alligator Push-up
Description: Push up with one arm positioned slightly forward of the other arm, while the other arm is in the normal push-up position.  Alternate hands after each push-up. Can be done as a traveling exercise.

Name: Alternating Shoulder taps
Description: From the plank position, alternate touching alternating hand to opposite shoulder.

Name: America Pie Sit-up
Description: A big girl sit up with a sitting forward fold to toe touch. Legs are flat on the ground - straight.

Name: American Hammers
Description: Seated in partial sit up position with heels off the ground, twist at the waist so that both hands held together touch the ground to the right side, then left side. Can also be done weighted - holding weight or any object in your hand. (Formerally Russian Twist)

Name: AMRAP
Description: As many reps as possible during a given time period

Name: Anchor Lift
Description: With feet shoulder-width apart, hold a dumbbell in both hands.  Lift arms together from waist to  overhead position, mimicking hoisting an anchor, then bring it back down.

Name: Angry Donkey Kick
Description: While in near crawl position, kick both feet into the air at the same time.

Name: Ankle Biter
Description: Laying on back, legs bent with feet on floor. Hands down by the side. Bend to right side touch right ankle, then bend to left side touch ankle. Can be counted in cadence.

Name: AO
Description: Area of Operation - Location of a workout.

Name: Arm Pendulum
Description: Hold a dumbbell with a straight arm. Move it in a big arc from side to side, like a dragon’s movement. (IC)

Name: Arm-ageddon
Description: Arm series. 25 Arms circles forward, 25 arm circles backward, 25 touchdown (Arms straight up and then down to chest level)25 rotate, 25 press together,. 25 overhead press. Q will make the PAX suffer by pausing between each exercise and at the end. Q calls out when to release/drop arms. Can also be done timed 30 secs each for 3 minutes.

Name: Arnold Press
Description: Begin with arms to the front, wrists over elbows (hands about chin height). Slowly move arms from front to side (in a “touchdown” position), then into an overhead press; reverse motion to return to original position with arms to the front and hands at chin height.

Name: Around the World
Description: Leg series. 10 right forward lunges, 10 right side lunges, 10 squats, 10 reverse Right lunges, 10 reverse left lunges, 10 jump squats, 10 left side lunges, 10 left forward lunges. Can be done with weights. (KC)

Name: Ascending Curb Crawl
Description: On a quiet curbed street or parking lot, Start on one side bear crawl to opposite curb, turn and place feet up on the curb complete one decline push-up then crawl back to other side do 2 decline pushups, continue until 13.

Name: Atomic Twist
Description: In standing position, feet width apart, holding weights on top of shoulders, perform one squat, then lift right knee to left elbow, then lift left knee to left elbow. That’s 1 rep.

Name: Baby Shark
Description: Ab routine to the Baby Shark song: Hold V Sit, Scissor Legs, Leg Lifts, V-Ups, Bicycles, In & Outs, Flutter Kicks, Mt. Climbers, V-Sit Arm Swipe, American Hammers Jazz Hands

Name: Back Blast
Description: A Write up of what happened in a workout. Responsibility of the workout Q.

Name: Bag of Abs
Description: A Ziploc bag full of popsicle sticks. Each stick has an ab exercise and rep count written on it. PAX draw a stick and lead the group to complete the exercise either in cadence or OYO. Example: 30 LBCs, 20 Flutter Kicks, 15 Leg Lifts. Bag of Abs is typically used at the end of a workout when you have 5-10 minutes left to spare. Introduced by Partly Cloudy. Embraced, loved, and utilized on the regular by FiA Cherokee.

Name: Bear Crawl
Description: Walk on the ground with both and hands and feet, like a bear. Knees are slightly bent

Name: Bear Crawl Dora
Description: Exactly what you think it is. A Dora. But, instead of running, 1 partner bear crawls to a defined destination and back.

Name: Bear Dogs
Description: A bird dog from a bear crawl position.  Start in bear crawl position and extend one arm straight in front of you while extending the opposite leg straight behind you before returning to bear crawl position. Then extend the other arm/leg combo. Reps can be two as one or one is one.

Name: Bear Squats
Description: In bear crawl position, bend knees like a squat.

Name: Bear Trap
Description: Bear crawl position but with weights in hands.  Do 2 renegade rows, then hop feet out to plank, and do 2 rows... Hop feet back into bear crawl, hover & row. Repeat.

Name: BeatDown (BD)
Description: A tough, challenging workout under the loving hands of your Q.

Name: Belly to the Wall
Description: Handstand up against a wall, belly facing toward the wall.  The closer to the wall the harder. Have PAX back into the wall.

Name: Bend and Snaps
Description: Combination Deadlift & Overhead Press.

Name: Bicycle
Description: Starting on back with legs bent at 45 degrees, hands behind head, alternate touching right elbow to left knee, then opposite. Simulate a bicycle movement. Can be counted in cadence.

Name: Big Girl Sit-up
Description: Old school sit ups, like you did in PE class.

Name: Bill Murray
Description: AKA Groundhog's Day. Q selects 4-5 exercises and reps. PAX complete exercises, run a lap, and repeat. Over and over and over again, just like Bill Murray in Groundhog's Day.

Name: Billy Blanks
Description: A series of embarrasing Tae Bo moves conducted in a public park for the duration of the Beatdown. Exercises include Cross Punches, Speed Bags, Bob N Weaves, Upper Cuts, Front Kicks, Back Kicks, Roundhouse Kicks, Overhead Side Reaches, Butterfly Taps, and Jabs. Coined by Partly Cloudy of FiA Cherokee, follower and lover of Billy Blanks and Tae Bo.

Name: Bird Dogs
Description: From hands and knees, extend one arm straight in front of you and the opposite leg straight behind you, return to starting position, and then do the other arm/leg combo. Reps can be two is one or one is one.

Name: Blackjack
Description: Similar to 11s, but with reps adding up to 21.

Name: BLIMPS
Description: 5 Burpees, 10 Lunges, 15 Imperial Walkers, 20 Merkins (Push Ups), 25 Plank Jacks, 30 Squats

Name: Boat Canoe
Description: An ab exercise where you move from boat position to a canoe position. Sit in a Pilates V position (that is boat), extend back and legs out to straighten yourself like a canoe then back up to boat.

Name: Body Builders
Description:
Position 1) Squat down and touch floor 
Position 2) Jump out to plank position
Position 3) Push up
Position 4) Plank Jack
Position 5) Jump back to squat position 
Position 6) Stand Up or Jump Squat

Name: Bojangles Biscuit
Description: Running routine completed on a track or school circle. Sprint straights, mosey corners. Add exercises if desired.

Name: BOMBS
Description: Dora, but you spell out BOMBS (50 Burpees, 100 Overhead Press, 150 Merkins, 200 Big Girl Sit Ups, 250 Squats

Name: Boo Boo Bear Crawl
Description: Same as bear crawl, except one leg is held up so it is a hopping motion instead of crawling.

Name: Boom Squats
Description: Pulsing squats and when the Q yells "Boom" do a jump squat

Name: BOPO
Description: One Regular Burpee, One One-Legged Burpee, One Burpee with a Plank Jack, and One One-Legged (other leg) Burpee. (Cherokee)

Name: Bourbons
Description: A Big Girl Sit up with a leg lift and torso twist at the top. Named after FiA Cherokee's Bourbon

Name: Bowling for Turkeys
Description:
This routine is to be completed using heavy weights
Complete sets in multiples of 3 reps, alternating legs with each set
Set 1 begins with right forward lunge, set 2 begins with left forward lunge, etc.
In Cadence (1,2,3-1... 1,2,3-2...)
(1) Double Bicep Curl
(2) (Right/Left) Forward lunge with opposite arm back extension
(3) Curtsy lunge with forward arm extension of same arm
Imagine you are holding a bowling ball about to get a strike. With (1) the double Bicep Curl, you are bringing the "ball" (weights) to your chest.  (2) Forward lunge, extending the opposite arm back, as if you were preparing to throw the bowling ball. (3) Curtsy as you bring your arm forward, as if you are releasing the ball down the lane. 
You’ve just completed your first rep and bowled your first strike.  Complete 3 reps to bowl your turkey.

Name: Box Cutters
Description: Lay on back, legs lifted 1-2 feet off the ground. Move feet out, down, in, up like you are tracing the outside and center of a box.

Name: Boy Bands
Description: Standing position. Jump and criss cross your legs left over right and then right over left, then drop down into a squat and touch the ground.

Name: Bradley Cooper
Description: One big girl sit up and one baby crunch ( that's how you get and like Bradley Cooper)

Name: Bridge Bugs
Description:
A Marching Glute Bridge with Skull Crusher.
Start on back and lift into glute bridge position with weight in hands on ground above your head. Alternate bringing one knee in at a time while raising weight in hands to meet the knee above you. Weight should return to ground above head each time and meet each knee above you as they march. Reps can be done as a one is one or two is one.

Name: Brooke Burke
Description: Plank position on elbows, rotate hips to one side almost touching the hip to the ground, return to plank neutral position, then rotate to other side. Slow movement. Can be done in cadence.

Name: Bruce Lee
Description: 6 Ab exercises followed by a lap. Completed 6 times. Reps determined by Q.

Name: Burp and Push
Description: Burpee with ascending pushup as the burpee is repeated. Can be done as a pyramid.

Name: Burpee
Description: 1. Stand feet shoulder distance apart. 2. Squat down hand on ground in front. 3. Shift weight to hands, kick legs back to a plank position. 4. Push up. 5. Jump feet to hands. 5. Return to standing position. 6. Jump in place.   REPEAT

Name: Burpee Broad Jump
Description: Burpee then instead of jumping in place, jump forward. Done as a traveling exercise.

Name: Burpee Island
Description: Divide Pax into groups in 4 corners with different assigned exercises. The middle of  the square is burpee island. Each group completed 25 reps of their assigned exercise, then runs to the middle (burpee island) to do 5 burpees before heading to their next corner. Rinse and repeat until all four corners are complete and then start a new round with 4 new exercises.

Name: Burps
Description: A burpee without the push-up

Name: Butler
Description: Hold arms with weights out extended as if holding a tray. (Alpha)

Name: Buzz Saw
Description: Plank position on your elbows, rock back and forth on your toes like a saw. (Kansas City)

Name: Cactus Jacks
Description: 4-count jumping jack. 1) feet apart, arms in T-position 2) feet together, arms in I-position above head 3) feet apart, arms in T-position 4) feet together, arms in I-position against legs

Name: Cadence
Description: Exercises done on a 4 count command by the Q. Example is Q shouts "1,2,3  1..1,2,3  2.... 1,2,3  3"

Name: Camel Walk
Description: Walk on ground with both hand and feet- like a camel, trying to keep legs straight.

Name: Candlestick Burpee
Description: Burpee with added movement between push up and jump up.  After push up, jump feet to hands, then rotate body so bottom is on the ground, roll back to heels to heaven, then roll back to feet, stand and jump. That is one rep.

Name: Captain Thor
Description: 1 Sit up, 4 American Hammers. Continue to increase reps with a 1:4 ratio until you are to 10 sit ups and 40 American hammers

Name: Carolina Dry Dock
Description: Modified push up. Bend elbows so your head drops down toward the ground. Like a downward dog push up.

Name: Carousel
Description: Pax in a circle on their backs heels up. First pax jumps up, going around the exterior of the circle pushing feet down (PAX don't let them touch the ground) other Pax are lifting heels to heaven while down, Pax runs back to spot, then next person goes.

Name: Century Club
Description: Partner up, using DORA (one pax runs while the other completes an exercise) work together to get to 100 reps of each exercise on a list.  i.e. pax 1 runs 50 yds out and back while pax 2 starts american hammers...they get to 36 when pax 1 returns, where they pick up the count and pax 2 starts running.  once 100 reps are reached as partners, they move to the next exercise on the list and ring a bell so the entire AO can cheer!

Name: Chain Breakers
Description:
This is a 4 count arm exercise (normally used during a warm up).  
With arms raised to chest height, put your fists toward the center of your chest with elbows facing out.  Then as if holding on to a chain and tugging it apart to break, do 3 small pulls of the elbows back ward, and the 4th pull release the arms/fists outward like you broke the chain (arms make a T) This 4th move stretches the chest and arms.  repeat-o

Name: Cherry Picker
Description: Stand shoulder width a part, bend at the waist, touch the right toe, touch in the middle of the feet on the ground, then touch the left toe then stand back straight. When beginning the next time start from the opposite side. Usually done in cadence. Good for warm up or stretch at the end.

Name: Chest Crushers
Description:
While lying on back, chest press weights straight up, then lower them above your head like a skull crusher, then bring elbows back down to your sides and weights back into position to chest press = 1 rep.
Combination of a Rolling Skull Crusher and Chest Press

Name: Circle of Trust (COT)
Description: A key part at the end of every FiA workout. Circle of Trust involves PAX congregating in a circle post beatdown for attendance count, Name-o-rama, announcements, and closing statment sending FiA's off with uplifting positive thoughts.

Name: Clippers
Description: Ab exercise lying on back, legs raised 6 inches from the ground. Keeping legs parallel to ground, separate legs outward then return to start.  (Formerally Dolly)

Name: Co Q
Description: When 2 Q's work together to Q a workout together.

Name: CofFIAteria (CofFiA)
Description: Where Pax gather post workout to drink coffee, chatter and fellowship

Name: Commando
Description: Plank up down then both shoulder taps - repeat. (Toledo South)

Name: Comms
Description: FiA Communication of any kind

Name: Convergence
Description: The act of bringing together FiA's typically from different sites or regions for workouts, SWAGs, or other events.

Name: Conveyor Belt
Description: PAX perform various exercises assigned to each parking space and move down the conveyor belt either on a timed basis or after a number of reps are completed. PAX in the very first parking space run to the very end and keep going down the belt.

Name: Court Jester
Description: Squat with an oblique side crunch (S. Charlotte)

Name: Crab Cake
Description: Face up in a crab walk position. Bring your right foot and left arm up to tap together, then return to ground. Bring your left foot and right arm up to tap together, then return to ground.

Name: Crab Walk
Description: Balancing on hand and feet facing up, hips raised up - walk like a crab.

Name: Crawl Bear
Description: Bear crawl except backwards

Name: Crazy 8’s
Description: 8 Reps of 8 exercises down in 8 minute rounds (AMRAP)

Name: Crazy Crabs
Description: In crab walk position, extend one leg out to ground and raise it up as high as possible before lowering back to ground and then bringing back to starting position.  Usually done alternating legs each time.

Name: Creepers
Description: in partial squat, walk a set distance on the balls of your feet, not allowing your heels to hit the ground.

Name: Criss Cross
Description: Standing with a dumbell in each hand in front of your torso in a line stacked one higher than the other. Pull elbows out to side and switch which weight is on top as you bring the weights back in to cross each other in front of your torso, each making a C shape on your torso.

Name: Criss Cross Applesauce LBCs
Description: Little Baby Crunches, but with your legs crossed flat on the ground. (Formerally Indian Style LBCs)

Name: Crockpot Squat
Description: Regular squat but lowering body slowly on the first 3 counts, lifting up on the 4th count. Weight should be in the heels.

Name: Crowne Jewel
Description: Stand with weighted ball or dumbbell. Pass it around your head (halo), then around your body, creating a circular motion.

Name: Crunchy Frog
Description: In a V-sit like position, wrap your arms around your legs, then quickly extend arms and legs out. Then bring them back in. Repeat.

Name: Cupid Shuffle
Description: In plank position, move to the song the Cupid Shuffle. Right leg out, Left leg out, Kick, down to push up.

Name: Curtsy Lunge
Description: Lunge variation where in lieu of bringing the back leg straight back, you bring toes back and across the body to the opposite side then lunge down. Alternating sides

Name: Cusack
Description: Stand and hold arms with weights straight over head (like John Cusack holding boombox in “Say Anything” movie poster)

Name: Cut It Out
Description: Ab series. Laying on back, hands under lower back for support, legs 6 inches off ground, 20 flutter kicks, 20 full scissor kicks up and down feet not touching, then 20 dollies. Repeat 3 times or can be done to a full song of choice.

Name: Dairy Queens
Description: Single Side Curtsy Lunge to a Lateral Leg Lift. Followed by a Sumo Squat with a Front Arm Raise (with or without dumbells). This is one rep. (Naperville)

Name: Dan Taylor
Description: 1 squat, 4 walking lunges. Reps continue with an increasing 1:4 ratio for a given distance. 2 squats, 8 lunges. 3 squats, 12 lunges. Etc. At the end, PAX feel like "they ain't got no legs"!

Name: Dead Bug
Description: Usually done with a dumbbell. LBC while holding a weight by its ends above your head, crunching your elbows to your knees while holding the weight.

Name: Deck of Death
Description: Q brings deck of cards. Each suit is assigned an exercise. PAX take turns drawing a card and completing the exercise determined by the suit and the reps determined by the value on the card. Royal cards are 10 reps, Aces are 15 typically.

Name: Decline Push-up
Description: Legs raised or elevated so that the push up accents the arms.

Name: Diamond Push-up
Description: Push-up while positioning both hands directly beneath chest with thumbs and forefingers touching forming what might look like a diamond between your hands.

Name: Dirty Mac Deuce
Description: 4 sets of 3 exercises done to 12 repetitions at a 4 count, with 12 seconds of rest in-between each set.  Each set consists of a chest /core/leg.

Name: DiveBombers
Description: Down dog, transition to a low hover plank bent elbows sweep the ribcage push forward on tippy toe into an up dog. FiA Winston-Salem

Name: Donkey Dogs
Description: Combination fire hydrant and donkey kick to a count of 4 to cover both sides

Name: Donkey Kick
Description: On all fours, lift one leg up, foot flexed, heel to the sky. Leg at 90 degree angle and pulse extending leg up and down. Switch leg.

Name: Door Knobs
Description: Arm exercise. Standing. Raise both arms out to the side so your body looks like a "T". With your hands, rotate your hands back and forth like you are turning a door knob. AKA Moroccan Night Club.

Name: Dora
Description: A partner exercise. One partner gets started on assigned reps, while the other partner runs. When the runner returns, they take over with reps picking up where the other left off. The other runs. Together the two PAX complete the total number of exercises.

Name: Dora MURPH
Description: MURPH workout. 1 mile, 100 pull ups (or 100 Burpees), 200 Push ups, 300 Squats, 1 mile run. Done as a Dora (Split with a partner)

Name: Doracides
Description: Dora workout, but the runner is running shuttle runs

Name: Dori
Description: Ab exercise. Lay on back, start with legs up perpedicular, lower legs down do a Clipper, then raise legs back up perpendicular at 90 degrees. (Thats one rep)

Name: Double Down
Description: Posting for 2 workouts, SWAGs or any other THANG in one day.

Name: Drops
Description: Standing position 1. Right hand to left high knee 2. Left hand to right high knee 3. Bring left foot up slap with right hand. 4. Bring right foot up slap with left hand 5. Squat  (That is one rep) Knee, Knee, foot, foot, squat. These can be done as a quick routine or slowly "walking it out"

Name: Duck Walk
Description: Squatting and walking slowly, while relying on your hips, quads, hamstrings and glutes for support.

Name: Dying Cockroach
Description: Ab exercise. Lay on back, arms/hands lifted toward the sky. Legs should do same movment as a slow bicycle extending each leg all the way straight before bringing it back in to chest.

Name: Elevens
Description: PAX do 1 rep of 1 exercise, run to different point and do 10 reps of another exercise. PAX continue to travel back and forth increasing the first exercise and decreasing the second to always add up to 11. (A shorter variation are 7's - done the same way)

Name: EMOM
Description: Every Minute on the Minute

Name: Empty Wheelbarrow
Description: A belly up plank walk while a partner holds feet. A crab walk with a partner.

Name: Escalator
Description: Same as a ladder.

Name: Failure to Launch
Description: A full body extension up to your tiptoes and hands overhead without actually leaving the ground then pull back down to a squat quickly and repeat.  (This is a modification for jumping.)

Name: False Starts
Description: Plank position. Jump knees in to chest, jump out back to plank, then 2 plank jacks. This is one rep. (Hampton Roads)

Name: Fancy Meeting You Here
Description: Everyone picks a favorite bodyweight exercise. Group runs around a defined area, half go clockwise, half go the other way. When you meet a FiA going the other way, you do their exercise and they do yours. Then you keep running the same direction you were going until you run into another FiA.

Name: Feather Stretch
Description: Simultaneous Tricep Kickback & Leg Kickback on Same Side (like a bird stretching its bird!) (Naperville)

Name: Fiddler Crab
Description: Perform a crab walk movement sideways

Name: Figure 4 Squat
Description: Cross one leg over other to make a 4, and squat.

Name: Figure 4 Squirrel
Description: While in the fig 4 squat position, add weights to your arms, and do a curl with every squat.  (squat+curl=squirrel)

Name: Figure 8s
Description: In a squat position, move 1 weight around both legs in a figure 8 shape.

Name: Fire Hydrant Extensions
Description: From hands and knees, raise one knee up to the side and then fully extend leg out to the side before bringing foot back in and then lowering knee to starting position.  Can be done alternating legs or staying on one side for maximum burn before switching.

Name: Fire Hydrants
Description: From hands and knees, raise one knee out to the side and up then back down. Can alternate legs or stay on same leg for maximum burn.

Name: Flaming Peter Parker
Description:
Combination Fire Hydrant, Peter Parker, then Donkey Kick.
Start on hands and knees. Raise one leg for a fire hydrant , then pull your leg up to the same elbow, then kick the same leg back and out like a donkey kick, then return to start position.  Repeat on other leg.

Name: Flash Side Lunge
Description: While side lunging, transfer hand weight from one foot to the other.

Name: Flutter Kick
Description: Ab exercise on back, legs 6 inches off ground doing alternating small kicks usually done in cadence.

Name: Flying Monkeys
Description: Monkey Humper and Michael Phelps Combo. Squat and bend into Monkey humper position,  instead of keeping hold of ankles, while moving rear up and down simultaneously swing arms out behind you and back in to hug yourself repeatedly.

Name: FNG
Description: Friendly New Gal - A female enjoying her first post

Name: Fold the Taco
Description: Laying flat on your back, legs straight, arms straight out. Bring leg straight up while sitting up with upper body. Alternate touching hand to opposite foot, like folding a taco one side at a time.

Name: Forties
Description: High rep version of 11's.  Start with 30 reps of one exercise and 10 of the other exercise. Subtract 5 from one side while you add 5 to the other. Example 30 dips / 10 push ups. 25 dips / 15 push ups, 20 dips / 20 push ups ....

Name: Four Corners
Description: PAX travel from corner to corner stopping for exercises at each. Travel between corners can vary from running to lunge walks to bear crawls. If time allows to go around the square multiple times, you can increase or decrease reps at each corner to make it an ascending or descending four corner routine.

Name: Four Corners Escalator
Description: Combo of Four corners and escalator.  4 exercises.First corner- 10 reps run to second corner 10 reps of new exercise + 20 reps of first corner.  Run to next corner 10 reps of new exercise, 20 reps of 2nd corner, 30 reps of 1st corner. Run to 4th corner 10 reps, 20 reps of 3rd corner, 30 reps of 2nd corner, 40 reps of 1st corner.

Name: Friday Night Lights
Description: A touch down with a snatch. Continuing to touch down while alternating arms with snatch.

Name: Frog Pumps
Description: Laying down, Place feet together and relax knees (in a diamond sit up position) then raise into glute bridge, and lower (Toledo South)

Name: Froggers
Description: Plank position, jump feet to outside of hands, then thrust back to plank position. Up and back is 1 rep.

Name: Froggie Yogi
Description: Stand on your tiptoes with your heels together, like a frog. Place your fingertips on the ground in front of you. Bend your knees and lower yourself like a frog while inhaling through your nose. Straighten your legs slightly while keeping your fingertips on the ground and exhale. Repeat the movement—lower as you inhale, rise as you exhale. This exercise strengthens your toes, ankles, calves, quads, and hamstrings all at once. (OQ)

Name: Fruit Loop’s loop
Description:
You will need cones and a large loop path. This routine can either be set up using a large loop or small loop. First set up 4-6 cones divided as evenly as you can on the loop path. Pax will divide up into pairs. Their partner should have similar arm strength as they will share one set of weights. Everyone starts at the first cone. Partner A will take off and sprint to the next cone. If using a large loop, this will be the next cone. If using a small loop, then they will sprint and keep running until they lap the cone they started at and then stop at the next cone.  When Partner A gets to the cone they will do the lower body exercise for that round. Meanwhile, Partner B will have the set of dumbbells and will take the same route as Partner A but while walking and doing the arm exercise for that round. Once Partner B gets to the cone where Partner A is waiting for them (because they ran there), they switch. Partner B gives the weights to Partner A and takes off running either to the next cone (large loop) or lap the cone they were just stopped at and then stopping at the next cone (small loop). As Partner B is running, Partner A is walking and doing the arm exercise. The round is over when the pair (Partner A and B) make it to the original cone where everyone started. 

Lower body is bodyweight only and completed at cones after running and while waiting for walking partner to get to cone. 
Upper body is done while walking.

Name: Full Moon Shuffle
Description: Use as a warm-up: Pax circle up, Pax can choose to say Shuffle Left, Shuffle Right or Full Moon(which means do a burpee) Begin with Q initiating shuffle then go around the circle each Pax calling out Left, Right or Full Moon. 2 rounds depending on number of pax.

Name: Glass Ceiling
Description: Curtsy Lunge into overhead press. Alternating sides

Name: Glitch
Description: When a computer glitches, you have to start back at the beginning. Same concept. Place 4 cones at least two parking spaces away. Do the exercise for cone 1 then run and do cone 2. Run back and repeat cone 1, then cone 2, then cone 3. Run back and complete cone 1, then 2, then 3, then 4.

Name: Goldilocks & the Three Bears
Description:
One (1) Big Girl Sit-up (Goldilocks). Flip Over to Bear Position. 
Do one (1) Shoulder Tap set, one (1) Hip Tap set, and one (1) Knee Tap set. Accumulator style: 2nd set - do 2 reps of each, 3rd set - do 3 reps of each, etc. and stopping when PAX is “ready for bed” or “just right" (Bloomington)

Name: Grass Grabbers
Description: Like Cherry pickers - except you move in cadence from front to back.  Stand, legs shoulder length apart, bend over touch the ground in the middle of your legs in the center top, center middle, center behind your legs.  Done in cadence as a warm up

Name: Greased Lightning
Description: From the Movie "Grease," this comes from the "Greased Lightning" song.  With legs in a wide squat position, one hand on waist one arm outstretched with finger pointing to right. Stay in squat position as you lift and pulse heels while outstretched arm and pointing finger moves from right to left (as if you are pointing at a really cool car racing by).  When you reach the other side, remain in squat and swap arms this time pointing from left to right.  Keep it up for 1 min or for as much of the song "Greased Lightning" you can remember and Karaoke the words to!

Name: Grizzly Press
Description: Reverse Lunge, overhead press, return to original stance. Repeat with alternate leg.

Name: Gun Show
Description: An arm exercise, obviously. One arm is extended out to the side, the other arm does a one-armed overhead press. The guns will be burning after 10-20 reps. Make sure to switch arms.

Name: Hacky Sack
Description: Squat, then stand and tap ankle to opposite hand like kicking a hacky sack, then squat again and do the opposite ankle. This is one rep. (Modification to the Soccer Kick)

Name: Hand Release Push-up
Description: Cross fit push up. Pushup performed by lowering all the way to belly, lifting hands off the ground, then back up to push up start position.

Name: Happy Jacks
Description: Jumping jacks in cadence, after 5 jumping jacks do 2 jump squats

Name: HC
Description: Abbreviation for HARD commit - as in  "Yes, I will be there!"

Name: Hedge Trimmers
Description: Ab Exercise, lay on back, legs raised to 90 degrees, keep legs perpendicular to the ground, separate legs outward then return to center. Heels should be flexed. (Formerally Rosalita)

Name: Heel Beats
Description: Lay on back, legs lifted off the ground. Beat heels together out and in.

Name: Helicopter
Description: Plank, hands closer together then shoulder distance. right hand and feet stay planted while you twist bent left arm elbow points towards the sky. rotate back to plank. Other side. Left hand on ground and rotate towards right, right elbow points towards the sky. Can be added to a tabata for nice oblique strengthener. FiA Winston-Salem

Name: High Five Push-up
Description: Partner plank facing each other. Push up together, on the way up reach out and high five with opposite hands repeat with opposite hands after next push up

Name: Hillbillies
Description: Not to be confused with Imperial Walkers. Hands behind head in upright, standing position. Bring same knee to same side elbow. Switch sides.

Name: Hip Dips
Description: From a side plank position, lower and raise hips almost touching the ground. Down and up is 1 rep

Name: Hoosier Hopper
Description: With one weight in your right hand, take two lateral hops to your left, bend at the waist and reach the weight with your palm facing out to the outside of your left foot. Return to standing and repeat in the opposite direction.

Name: Hopscotch Jump
Description: Jump alternating between 2 feet then 1 foot like jumping on a hopscotch board

Name: Imperial March
Description: Song: The Imperial March... imperial walkers during drum beat of the march, Raggedy Anns in between

Name: Imperial Squat Walker
Description: A four count exercise. 1 squat, 2 leg up opposite knee to elbow, 3 squat, 4 other leg up oppostie knee to elbow

Name: Imperial Walker
Description: Hands behind head in upright, standing position. Bring opposite knee to elbow, then switch sides.

Name: Inchworm
Description: Standing, bend over touch hands to ground, then start walking hands out until body is in the plank position. pause one second in plank, the walk hands back and then full stand up. This is one rep.

Name: Inchworm Burpees
Description: An inchworm with a hand release push up once you get to plank and a vertical jump after inchworming back to standing position.

Name: IWY Superman
Description: Lay on the ground on belly, legs tight together, lifted slightly off the ground. Arms are up (by ears like a touchdown sign)Arms make the letter I then a Y and then a W (squeezing through the back) - This is one rep. Arms go back up to ears.

Name: Jack in the Box
Description: A Raggedy Ann with a star jump squat (South Coast)

Name: Jack Jack
Description: One Jumping Jack and One Plank Jack

Name: Jack Webb
Description: Push up then air press combination initiated on the Q's command. Ascending rep count of each usually up to 10

Name: Jedi Jacks
Description: Jacks 5 ways done in a series. Regular jacks, Seal Jacks, Soldier Jacks, Star Jacks and Plank Jacks. Reps can vary, but usually 10 reps each. Good to use when you are explaining the next thing you are going to do in a workout so PAX are not standing still.

Name: Jello Shooters
Description: Arms raises with weights, left arm front raise right arm side raise, then switch. Arms feel like jello when done (Charlottesville)

Name: Jigsaw Special
Description: Sit on mat with legs extended and feet together. Place hand weight or water bottle on one side of feet. Raise legs together over the object to the other side and tap the ground. Continue movement back and forth.

Name: Jump Jump
Description: Using the Kriss Kross song “jump jump”, do squats throughout the song, each time they say “jump”, jump up

Name: Jump Shots
Description: Standing position, squat down and pick up your imaginary basketball and shoot a jump shot with right hand, then repeat again this time shooting with left hand

Name: Jumping Spider
Description: A 1/2 burpee with a Peter Parker. Jump to plank, bring right knee up to right elbow, left knee to left elbow, back to plank, jump up like the finish of a burpee (Naperville)

Name: Kangaroos
Description: 4 count High Knee, hands tapping your knees, then a full squat where you touch the ground. This is one rep. (Cherokee)

Name: King of the Castle
Description: Q provides coins to PAX. PAX do 10 of an exercise (typically ab, such as Bourbons), flip the coin. If head, keep going and do 10 more. If tails, do 5 of a second exercise (Burpees) then the 10 of the original exercise. Flip the coin again and continue for 10 rounds, until 100 reps are complete. Those that finish first win a lap!

Name: Kiss the Baby
Description: Push up position, place a weight between hands, lower body for pushup and kiss the weight. Encourages pax to get lower in the push-up. (Hampton Roads)

Name: Kraken
Description:
This mythical beast of a routine that resembles an octopus consists of 8 stations set around a large circle, each with an exercise. PAX spread out across the stations, complete the specified exercise, then run the outside of the full circle past the station they just completed, to the next station (so a full circle + 1 cone). PAX continue around the circle. 20 reps should be completed for each exercise in the first round. Then 15 in round 2. Then 10 in round 3 and so forth as time allows.
Alternative: Spice it up with a Reverse (Demon) Kraken with increaing reps each round.

Name: Ladder
Description: A series of exercises where you tack on a new exercise with each round. Start with push ups for example. Then do push ups and burpees. Then do push ups, burpees, and squats. Etc.

Name: Lady Bugs
Description: Lay on back and raise both knees with calves/feet parallel to the ground (like you would when seated in a chair, but tipped on your back) Alternate tapping each toe to the ground and raising it back to starting position.

Name: LBCs
Description: Little Baby Crunches - on your back in beginning sit up form, but shoulders only come slightly off the ground.

Name: Leg Pendulum
Description: Squat, right lateral leg raise, squat, left lateral leg raise. (That is one rep) Making sure foot is flexed on lateral leg lift.

Name: Leg Throwdown
Description: Partner 1 lies on back, partner 2 stands above partner 1 head. Partner 1 holds partner 2 ankles. Partner 1 raises legs, heels flexed to sky, Partner 2 pushes Partner 1 legs to the ground, Partner 1 tries to not let legs touch the ground. Can push legs side to side and hard and soft.

Name: Leg Wrecker
Description: Split PAX into 2 Groups at opposite ends of area. 1 group does reps while the other group does Lt. Dan until they get to the other end. Groups switch.

Name: Lexirades
Description: Charades using the FiA Lexicon. Put exercises in a cup, teams pull exercises from cup and perform the exercise, others try to guess the FiA name of the exercise.

Name: Lion Throne Squat
Description: Hold dumbbells at chest level in sumo squat position. Shift weight to one leg and place the other foot on the inner thigh like a tree pose. Return to start and repeat.

Name: Lion’s Leap Lunge
Description: Step forward into a lunge, pull same leg back into high knee position with pointed toe like in a lion dance. Return to start and repeat. (OQ)

Name: Load the Buses
Description: Mosey over to the bus lanes at your local school or a long parking lot with well marked spaces. Select 4 exercises to rotate through. Start at the beginning (bus lane #1) and run down to the last one, do the first exercise and run all the way back. Do 1 burpee at the starting line. Next, run down to the second to last bus lane, do the second exercise, run back to the start, and complete 1 burpee. These are like shuttle runs. Rotate through the 4 exercises. If your spaces are numbered, use the numbers to determine the reps, or set your own number of reps. Continue until you have completed exercises in every bus lane or parking spot.

Name: London Bridge
Description: Marching glute bridges and glute bridge pulses in a musical cadence to the tune of Fergie's London Bridge. Watch the YouTube video for timing instructions. Https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=BJL-PKF06-Y

Name: Loop de Lou
Description: Find a circle to run, like a school drop off lane/circle or in a parking lot create a circle. Partner up. Complete an exercise (ex:30 Push Ups) then run opposite ways on the loop. Once you meet on the loop, complete another set of the same exercise. Run back to start, continuing on your path. Q calls an exercise to do while waiting for all runners to return to start. Rinse and repeat with other exercises. (Cape Fear)

Name: Lovebug
Description: 5 Tricep Dips with 1 Leg Up/Extended. Flip over, do 5 one-leg push ups with same leg extended. Flip over, do 5 Tricep Dips with other leg extended. Flip over, do 5 one-leg push ups with other leg extended. Continue.

Name: Lunge Squat
Description: Forward Lunge + Squat + Backwards Lunge on same side. This is one rep. Perform as soft count.

Name: Manmaker
Description: Burpee, prior to doing push up, row from push up position right arm , then push up then row left arm, then finish the burpee. Can be done with weights.

Name: Marching Glute Bridge
Description: Start lying on back with knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Press through your heels and lift your hips off the ground into a glute bridge. Keeping lips up and core engaged, lift one foot off the ground, then back down to ground. Alternate between legs as you are "marching" while maintaing the bridge position.

Name: Marionettes
Description: Start in bent over row position with elbows out to side. Rotate forearms up until parallel with ground, pause, and rotate down.

Name: Mat Taps
Description: Standing position, side shuffle to the right 2 times (length of a yoga mat), reach down with right hand and tap the ground, then side shuffle back to the left the length of your "mat" and tap the ground with your left hand. Tapping on right then left is 1 rep.

Name: Merkins
Description: Another word for push-ups.

Name: Michael Phelps
Description: Arm warm-up: arms straight out in a "T" swing arms in to give yourself a hug, then back out, repeat motion quickly. Think of what Michael Phelps does before he swims.

Name: Mike Tyson
Description: Plank position, push your bottom back towards your heels, staying parallel to ground, push forward into a push up. For an added challenge, put your feet on a wall.

Name: Million Dollar Woman
Description: GROUP ENGAGING - with pax in a circle, pick 1 person to be the one to "chase" on an exercise.  (plan 10-15 exercises, repeat @ 20 reps round 1, 30 reps r2, 40 reps r3) starting with exercise 1 - the million dollar woman starts her reps (i.e. 20 skaters) the rest of the group has a 3 burpee start/penalty, then does the 40 skaters trying to finish before the MDW.  first one to shout DONE ends the exercise for EVERYONE.  The next pax in the circle is now the MDW and does exercise #2 while the group starts their burpees and tries to catch her.  NOTE - burpees does not always have to be the penalty, it could be anything: mtn climbers, pushups, etc...  *give your pax time to catch their breath inbetween, its an adrenaline rush!  This workout routine always gets great feedback :)

Name: Miyagi Drummers
Description: Hold a squat stance with arms held in a "W" position. Twist your torso toward the midline like hitting a drum without letting your hips move;  just like in Karate Kid.

Name: Monkey Humpers
Description: Squat, hold on to ankles, and move your rear up and down like a humping monkey.

Name: Mosey
Description: Another word for jogging.

Name: Motivators
Description:
Jumping Jack Routine - Count down from 10 reps
10 full Jumping Jacks, 10 Jumping jacks where arms only raise as high as shoulders, 10 JJ with hands on hips, 10 straight jumps up and down....then 9 full JJ, 9 arms half way JJ, 9 JJ only legs, 9 bouncing straight up and down... then 8 reps 7,6,5,4,3,2,1.

Name: Mountain Climber
Description: Plank position, bring one knee up alternating. Climbing motion. can be done in cadence.

Name: Name-O-Rama
Description: The part of the COT where PAX announce their birth name, Age and FiA Name.

Name: Narrow Squat
Description: Just like a basic squat but with your legs together

Name: Narrow Squate with Kickback
Description: A narrow squat, but with an added kick backwards as you come up. Squeeze at the top of the kick.

Name: Narwhals
Description: A one legged glute bridge. (One leg is in the air like a narwhal horn)

Name: Never Have I Ever
Description: Often used as a warm up. Q calls out a Never Have I Ever topic. If PAX HAVE they do one exercise, if PAX HAVE NEVER they do another exercise. Can be used with side shuffles left or right to better identify those guilty and those not. This warm up always results in great chatter and laughter.

Name: Ninja Jumps
Description: Start from a prisoner squat (squat one leg at a time to the ground) until both knees are on the ground, with the top of your feet on the ground. From that position jump up into a squat.

Name: Nola Special
Description: In a seated position with legs straight out in front and separated roughly shoulder width apart, place a weight at your feet in an upright position. Place your hands behind you on the ground near your bottom for support. One at a time, each leg goes up and over the weight. Can be done as a slow count on Q or double time count in cadence.

Name: Otter Pockets
Description: Alternating cross-body bicep curls. Curl weight to front of opposite armpit (like a sea otter putting things in it's armpit pockets!) (Naperville)

Name: Overhead Clap
Description: Stand with arms at side. Raise arms without bending at the elbows to a clap overhead. Think the snow angel arm movement

Name: P•I•V•O•T Squats
Description:
Start in standing position with weights on shoulders. 
Count (1) Squat 
Count (2) Pivot on toe with right foot 
Count (3) Pivot on toe with left foot 
Count (4) Return to squat
In Cadenacve

Name: Paincakes
Description: PAX complete 1 Big Girl Sit Up, roll over, complete 1 Push Up. Roll over and complete 2 Big Girl Sit Ups, roll over, and do 2 Push Ups. This continues all the way to 10 of each.

Name: Paint Roller
Description: Hold a weight in each hand. Stand up straight with arms down and straight. Start by bending at your waist from side-to-side. Pretend your weights are paint rollers and you are painting the outside of your thighs continuously.

Name: Parker Peter
Description: Same as Peter Parker except opposite knee to elbow.

Name: Parking Space Tracer (PST)
Description: PAX stand on parking spot line and side step, run backwards, run forwards to trace the line for a given amount of time.

Name: Parking Space workout
Description: 10 parking spaces, use chalk to make each parking space a different exercise. Divide the group so each parking space has even amount of people. Set a timer, stay in each parking space 1 minute, 15 secs rest - move to next parking space to the left. After a full rotation of all spaces, next round do 30 secs in each space.  Great for Parking garages (Kansas City)

Name: Party Bear
Description: Start in bear crawl position, using right leg first, bring knee into chest, then back to bear position, then cross the right foot over left leg and back to bear position (that's 1 rep). Repeat on left leg. Goal is to keep leg lifted off the ground while performing exercise. (IC)

Name: PAX
Description: People in attendance at the workout.

Name: Peek-A-Boo
Description: With weights in hands, hold arms together in front of face with elbows at 90 degrees (covering face), then open up both arms to the side in a goal post position.

Name: Peter Parker
Description: Plank position, move left knee up to left elbow, then right knee up to right elbow. Feet should be flexed. Should look like Spider-Man.

Name: Pickles
Description: F3 group working out in a FiA AO

Name: Pillar Cross
Description:
4 Count exiercise with starting position standing with weights by side.
Count 1: Raise arms in lateral arm lift to shoulder height.
Count 2: Open arms to side of body in T-shape stance. 
Count 3: Close arms back to lateral arm lift position. 
Count 4: Lower arms down from lateral arm lift position.

Name: Pistol Squat
Description: One-legged squat down while keeping the other leg extended straight out in front of the body.

Name: PJ Inchworm
Description: Inchworm with a push and a jump. Start in a standing position and reach to your toes, then walk your hands out to a plank position and do a push up. Walk your feet to your hands and do a jump squat.  (Brunswick)

Name: Plank
Description: Toes and hands or elbows are the only body parts touching the ground. Body should look like a board.

Name: Plank Jack
Description: Plank position, move legs out and in like doing a jumping jack

Name: Plank Up Downs
Description: Start in a high plank, move down to forearms/elbows, then back up to high plank.

Name: Plank, Tap, Climb
Description: Start in a high plank position. Tap right foot out to the side. Tap left foot out to the side. Do one Mountain Climber (each knee comes up once). Then back to plank position and repeat.

Name: Popcorns
Description: Squat thrust (legs out to high plank then back to squat) then 2 jump squats (Charlottesville)

Name: Post
Description: To show up physically for a workout or event.

Name: Power Salute Curl
Description: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand. Hammer curl up. At the top, cover the fist holding the dumbell with the palm of the empty hand in a martial arts style "salute."  Lower and repeat.

Name: Powerhouse Punch
Description: In a low sumo squat, alternating front punches with weights.

Name: Prayer Squat
Description: A body weight squat performed with hands together clasped in front of your chest.

Name: Pretzel Crunch
Description: Start in sit up position.  Lift left leg and put your left foot on right knee. Put your left arm straight out and your right arm behind the head. Bring elbow to left knee then back down. Switch sides and repeat.

Name: Pretzel Stick
Description: Pretzel crunch except with legs straight out and cross one foot onto the opposite knee. Upper body is same as pretzel crunch. Switch sides and repeat

Name: Prisoner Squat
Description: Body weight squat performed with hands on your head or laced behind your head.

Name: Protractor
Description: While laying on your back, Q calls various angles to hold legs at, such as 10 degrees, 30, 90. Also fun to engage the PAX and call out other FiA determine degree.

Name: Pullover
Description: Lie on your back with weight pressed up above chest. Lower weight behind head to just above the ground without bending at the elbows (straight arms).

Name: Pyramid of Pain
Description: Start with 5 exercises, lower reps, run 5 laps. Do 4 exercises, higher reps, run 4 laps. Do 3 exercises, higher reps, run 3 laps. Do 2 expercises, even higher reps, run 2 laps. Do 1 exercise, very high reps, run 1 lap.

Name: Q
Description: The leader of a given workout, or any other FiA event. Derivation - "Qrusader in charge"

Name: Quarter Planks
Description: 15 second plank/ 15 reps of an exercise, 30 sec plank / 30 reps of exercise, 45 sec plank/45 reps of exercise, 60 sec plank/ 60 reps of an exercise THEN work your way back down. Move quickly from one thing to the next. (Kansas City)

Name: Queens
Description: Combo move: Curtsey Lunge on one side, one pulse then a lateral leg lift. Easiest to be repeated all on one side, then repeat with the other leg.

Name: Raggedy Ann
Description: In a sumo position, hands laced behind the head at the ears, alternate sides reach one had down and touch the heel of the same side then repeat on the other side. Bending at the waist, keeping the back straight.

Name: Rainbow Taps
Description: Start on hands and knees with one leg extend out with toe on ground. Lift leg up and over to one side, tapping toe on ground. Rainbow arch toe back to tap on other side. Repeat back and forth.

Name: Ratchet Squat
Description: Squat, quarter turn to the left and back. Squat quarter turn to the right and back.

Name: Release the Frog
Description: Chest to ground, push up into plank, the jump with both feet up into a squat.

Name: Renegade Row
Description: Can be performed with weights or no weights. Plank position, row right arm, then left arm, then do a push up.

Name: Reverse Burpee
Description: From standing, roll back (like a backwards summer sault) to shoulders, then gain momentum rolling forward to standing - attempting to do so without using hands- then add a straight jump up.  come down and roll back again (Toledo South)

Name: Reverse Crunch
Description: Same position as LBC, head stays on ground, bend knees to 45 degrees and curl to chest.

Name: Reverse Palm Flips
Description: From the Squat position, with arms out behind you holding your weights in each hand, flip your palm over and back. (UK Southeast)

Name: Reverse Plank
Description: Same as plank, facing upward arms and legs straight, feet are flat

Name: Rhino
Description: Combination Carolina Dry Dock and Zebra Kick. From downward dog position, pushup by dropping head toward ground, then kick each leg one at a time up into the air. Full combo equals 1 rep.

Name: Rhino Crawl
Description: An Accumulator with Rhinos and Bear Crawls. Start with 1 Rhino (carolina dry dock/Zebra kicks), then 2 strides of Bear Crawl. Follow by 2 Rhinos then 4 strides of Bear Crawl using accumulator counting.

Name: Ring of Fire
Description: PAX form a circle. All PAX do 1 exercise. Q passes a different exercise around the circle. Example: all PAX hold plank. Q starts 5 shoulder taps. PAX to left does 5 shoulder taps as soon as the Q is done. Each PAX completes shoulder taps once the person to their right is done until it gets all the way around the circle and back to the Q.

Name: Ring of Fire Wave
Description: PAX in a circle like Ring of fire. Series of Static and hold moves in a wave. Example: Q has everyone hold a squat, Q starts and drops to a plank, person to the right then follows and drops to a plank, quickly all the way around the circle. When it get back to the Q, she pops back up into a squat hold and rest of pax follow. They continue to go back and forth between Plank and squat hold until the song is over. This is usually done to a song.

Name: Rocket Launch
Description:
SLOW BURPEE: 3-Sec Plank Hold, 3-Sec Squat Hold, 3 Squat Jumps, and 3-Sec Squat Hold
Move slowly through a burpee, holding the plank and squat positions, then explode into squat jumps.

Name: Rocket Squat
Description: 3 count down into a deep squat, on 4th count shoot up into a jump squat like a rocket

Name: Rolling Skull Crusher
Description: Lay down on mat. Narrow chest press to a slow 3-count skull crusher down. Drop elbows back to mat. Repeat in a circular motion. (Hampton Roads)

Name: Route 66
Description: Start with 1 rep  then add one additional rep at an interval until you hit 11. Example: Moving along a path with lamp post or parking lot markers, do one Burpee, next marker 2 burpee, 3rd 3 burpee... until you get to 11 which will result in 66 reps.

Name: Rowboat
Description: Sit with hands on ground behind slightly behind bottom, bring knees in and out at chest level like a rowboat.

Name: Ruck
Description: Weighted backpack often worn during a walk to increase calorie burn and intensity.

Name: Sally
Description: To the song Flowers by Moby, PAX get in an elbow plank position. Every time the lyrics say “Bring Sally Up”, PAX go to a high plank position. Every time the lyrics say “Bring Sally Down”, PAX return to elbows. This can also be done with squats, rather than planks.

Name: Salty Pretzels
Description:
Start with arms straight out in “T” position with thumbs facing up. 
Count 1: Bend elbows to bring thumbs to shoulders.
Count 2: Straighten elbows back out.
Count 3: With arms still extended to the side, rotate thumbs down.
Count 4: Rotate thumbs back up to starting position. 
4 Count IC

Name: Scorpion Dry Dock
Description: Carolina dry dock with one leg hoisted in the air higher than your bottom.

Name: Scorpion Push-up
Description: A push-up performed with one leg hoisted in the air higher than your bottom.

Name: Scuba Scrubbers
Description: Lying on belly, raise chest up and make circular motions with hands in front of you while simultaneously flutter kicking (like a scuba diver cleaning a pool)

Name: Seal Jacks
Description: Jumping jack but with arms in front instead of over head.

Name: See You When I See You
Description: PAX partner up and run opposite directions from one another in a circle. When partners meet back up, they perform a series of exercises together: 10 Push Ups, 10 Sit Ups, 10 Squats, 10 dips. They run opposite directions again and continue decreasing reps with each round. 9 of each, 8, 7, 6, etc. Great for PAX of varying running speeds.

Name: Severna Squat
Description: Squat to Front kicks

Name: Short, Longer, Longest
Description: An internal timer routine. Each round has 3 exercises, the first completed for 30 seconds, the second completed for 45 seconds, and the third completed for a full minute. We suggest a plank or wall sit for a full minute, followed by a run between rounds. There is usually enough time for 5-6 rounds completed twice.

Name: Shuttle Run
Description: Set up markers (or use parking spots) for short sprints.  Start at a baseline and sprint to a point 10-20 feet away, touch the ground, then sprint back to the stating point. Continue to run out to a further distance, touch the ground, and sprint back, progressively increasing the distance with each run. (Formerally known as suicides)

Name: Side Lunge Squats
Description: Side lunge to right + Squat + Side lunge to left. This is one rep.

Name: Sigma
Description:
2 Chest Flys + 2 Straight Arm Pullovers
Lie on your back or stand with dumbbells. Open your arms wide for a chest fly, then pull them straight back.

Name: Silly Sprints
Description: Place a deck of cards at a cone a good distance away. PAX run to cone, pick a card, and run back to mats to complete their exercise. The suit on the card selected determines the exercise and the number determines reps. PAX run to select another card once exercises are completed. This continues for 10-15 minutes or until cards run out. PAX with most cards is the winner!

Name: Skinny
Description: What really happened at the workout or event. Q commentary about the workout.

Name: Skyclimbers
Description: Lay on back with legs straight up together pointing toes to the sky. Do "mountain climber" move with legs. (IC)

Name: Sleepwalkers
Description: If Lt. Dan could Sleepwalk, this would be it. 1 Squat, 2 Toe Touches, 3 Walking Lunges. Then 2 Squats, 4 Toe Touches, 6 Walking Lunges. Then 3 Squats, 6 Toe Touches, and 9 Walking Lunges. Continue to determined destination or maximum rep of Q's choice.

Name: Sloth Crunch
Description: Start on back with hands and feet raised straight into the air as high as possible, bringing hips and shoulders off the ground (like a hanging sloth). Crunch in this position.

Name: Sloth Hold
Description: Start on back with hands and feet raised straight into the air as high as possible, bringing hips and shoulders off the ground (like a hanging sloth). Hold in crunch position.

Name: Slurpee
Description: Burpee with 2 push ups

Name: Smurf Jacks
Description: Jacks performed in a squat position.

Name: Snow Angels
Description: In standing position with weight in hands, arms down by sides with palms facing out, raise arms to above head (making a snow Angel move with arms), return arms back down by sides, that’s 1 rep.

Name: Soccer Kicks
Description: Start from a standing position with both feet directly under the hips and arms at the sides. With one leg jump and internally rotate at the knee bringing the ankle up the hip, reach and tap the ankle with the opposite hand and return back to the ground. Alternate side to side.

Name: Soldier Jack
Description: Jumping jack except legs move front to back instead of side to side. Arms are the same as regular jack.

Name: Solo
Description: Start with back flat on ground and legs extended out 6 inches above ground—do a Clipper (out and in) then a flutter kick. Repeat. (Chatt)

Name: Sparky Crabs
Description: Crab walk position, lift one hand and opposite foot, touching hand to foot, return switching to opposite side. Good to do in cadence. (Metro)

Name: Speed Skaters
Description: Side to side lunge movement while reaching hand across the body to the opposite foot.

Name: Spider-Man Crawl
Description: A moving Peter Parker, similar to a bear crawl but elbow meets hands.

Name: Split Squat
Description: Lunge done with top of one foot resting on a higher surface such as a bench or wall. Hands on hips, drop straight down careful not to let knee go over toe. Repeat on other leg.

Name: Squat Thrust
Description: (Spartan Burpee) Burpee with no push up

Name: Squirrel
Description: Squat + Bi-Cep Curl = Squirrel

Name: Star Jack
Description: Combo of jumping jack and jump squat. Squat, jump and arms spread in a"V" so together the legs and the arms make an X

Name: Star Jack Burpee
Description: Burpee with a star jump at the end instead of jump

Name: Stargazers
Description: Lay on your back, arms out wide, legs flat on the ground. Relax. (Formerally Lindsay Lohan)

Name: Statue of Liberty
Description: With a weight in 1 hand(right for this example) same side leg bends up at the knee, so you are standing on the opposite leg (left) Do a single leg squat-touching the weight to the left foot.  Then stand up while doing a fly arm with the weight all the way up.  continue to only stand on 1 leg. *this is great for balance, do not bend over, squat down! this is a single leg squat, not a row* Try 5-10 on one side before switching sides.

Name: Stretch-O-Rama
Description: PAX calls out a stretch for everyone to do, then move on to the next pax who picks a different stretch to do, and so forth, like ab-o-rama.

Name: Suitcase Squat
Description: Narrow Squat, arms are down like holding two suitcases. Can be done with weights.

Name: Super 21
Description: 1 Push Up, 1 Sit Up. 2 Push Ups, 2 Sit Ups. All the way to 21 of each.

Name: Super Gardeners
Description: Broad Jump Weed Pullers. Place a dumbbell at each end of the mat. Then broad jump from one end to the other while while doing a single arm dumbbell snatch. Use lower body, keeping weight close to you as you lift it - it should feel light at the top.

Name: Super Mario Jump
Description: Start in low lunge with opposite hand on the ground. Stand and drive opposite leg up as you hop then return to start position. You will look like Super Mario jumping for a coin

Name: Super Mario Run
Description: Run. Varying distance of 2-5 miles. Pax start out together, stopping at various designated places along the route to perform strength exercises. This also allow pax to regroup. Extra stops can be given to faster runners, allowing everyone to finish at the same time. Named from Peel - Metro. Also called a Ring Run.

Name: Super Squirrels
Description: Squat/Curl/Thruster Combo. Start with a Squirrel (squat and bicep curl) but thrust onto an overhead press as you stand from your squat instead of lowering from the curl. Lower weights back down to sides before starting next rep.

Name: Superwoman (Superman)
Description: Lay on belly, raise arms up over your head, lift at the same time slightly lift arms and feet off the ground at the same time. Then back down. Repeat.

Name: Superman Banana
Description: Start in Superman position (laying belly on ground, arms and legs lifted off the ground), hold this until Q calls Banana then roll over still holding legs and arms off the ground. Hold until Q calls Superman again. Goal is to not touch arms and legs to the ground.

Name: Superman IYW
Description: Superman position - raise arms to make an I, then a Y and then a W - Repeat (Kansas City)

Name: Supines
Description: Sit up executed laying flat on back, legs flat on ground, sit up, reach through and touch toes and roll back down.

Name: Surrenders
Description: Move from a standing position to a kneeling position keeping your hands up (like you are surrendering) at all times (weights are encouraged).

Name: SWAG
Description: (Strong Women Achieving Greatness) A convergence of sorts where FiA gather to compete in events to further their greatness and set goals achieving higher success. (FiA positive spin on CSAUP)

Name: Tabata
Description: A 4 minute routine that involves 20 seconds of work followed by 10 seconds of rest repeated 8 times, for a total of 4 minutes. Can be repeated several times with various exercises.

Name: TAP
Description: Short for Thoughts and Prayers- quick way to let a FiA know you are thinking of her.

Name: Tarantula
Description: Starting In Squat Position - Jump Lunge Right Foot Lead, Jump Lunge Left Foot Lead, Jump Squat = 1 rep (Naperville)

Name: Tea Pots
Description: Stand with one hand behind head and opposite arm holding a heavy weight. Lean body so weight slides down your leg, like a teapot tipping, then lean up and crunch your opposite elbow toward the other hip so the weight slides up your leg.

Name: Tempo Push-up
Description: Push up in cadence with 3 count down 1 count up

Name: Tennessee Whiskeys
Description: A lateral arm raise like the letter T and then a W arm press out

Name: THAT THANG
Description: The Workout. The work that was done. No commentary.

Name: The Broncs
Description:
Start in kneeling position holding weights in each hand at chest.
Rock your body back as your booty touches your heels.
Extend arms to tricep kickback. Rock back to starting position.

Name: The Dab
Description: 10 burpees per minute for 5 minutes, run 1/4 mile, rinse and repeat x 4.

Name: The Millennial
Description: Q Selects 10 exercises. PAX all start together on 1 of the exercises, trying to get to 100 reps. The first PAX that hits 100 calls it out and all PAX stop and run a lap together. PAX then all start together on the 2nd exercise and try to get to 100. 100 reps x 10 exercises = 1,000. The last exercise is typically burpees and the winner/leader from each of the previous 9 exercises can take a turn leading the PAX in 10 burpee sets.

Name: The W.A.S.H
Description: 50 Werkins (wide arm push ups), 100 American Hammers (Russian twists), 150 Step Ups, 200 Hip Thrusters (kind of like a glute bridge but up in crab cake position)

Name: The Willow
Description: Starting position holding weight with arms extended to make a T position. Lower right arm. Lower left arm. Raise both arms. = 1 rep

Name: Thread the Needle
Description: In side plank, raise upper arm to the sky.  Then swoop down the arm to 'thread' it thru the space between the ground and the arm holding the plank.  Raise that arm back to the sky again.  Stay on one side until reps are complete, then switch sides.

Name: Thruster
Description: A squat and overhead press combo. With weights of choice held at shoulder level, squat and when coming up from squat, press weights overhead in one fluid motion.

Name: Thruster Mountain
Description: An EMOM workout of only thrusters (squat/overhead press) with ascending reps up to minute 23 and then descending reps back down to 1! (i.e. 1 thruster at 1 min, 2 thrusters at 2 min... 23 thrusters at 23 minutes, 22 thrusters at 24 min..  1 thruster at 45 min.) Your heart rate will look like a mountain peak by the end! Think it's easy? I bet you change your mind at minute 14... Can you get all 529 reps?

Name: Thunder Sit-up
Description: In standard sit up position, lay down, and when you sit completely up, smack the ground with your hands (either in between your legs/feet, or to the sides of your legs).  Repeat with each sit up.  Get the pax pumped up to bring the thunder and smack the ground like they mean it!

Name: Thunderstruck
Description: To the song: Thunderstruck - 2 exercises, 1 of choice other is burpee - every time they say thunderstruck you do a burpee.

Name: Toni's
Description: Standing- place right hand behind head. Bring right knee up and touch right elbow to right knee, then bring left knee up and reach across to touch right elbow to left knee. This is one rep. Do 10 on right side, then switch to the Left side. (Kansas City)

Name: Top Gun
Description: AMRAP 10 reps of 5 exercises for 10 minutes total. Danger Zone happens every minute on the minute and requires PAX to do 3 burpees, then return to reps and exercises. Good to do with arm exercises for a total arm burnout.

Name: Tortoise and the Hare
Description: 2 Pax of similar speed, one with a rock or weighted object starts running with a  head start, 2nd pax attempts to run down the first tagging them then switching. Continue until Q calls or returned to the starting point. Easily done on a track.

Name: Train Run
Description: PAX line up single file and mosey slowly. PAX at the very end sprints to the front and calls out an answer to the Q's topic of choice. This continues until all the way back to the start and every PAX has sprinted. Often used as a warm up. (Formerally Indian Run)

Name: Tricep dip
Description: Done best on an elevated surface (bench, curb, step) crab walk position with hand on elevated surface, lower the body using just arms dipping down below the elevated object.

Name: Triple Check
Description: PAX form groups of 3. 1 PAX goes to one station to complete an exercise. Another PAX goes to a second station to complete a different exercise. The 3rd PAX runs. When the runner returns, PAX rotate. Each PAX should complete each station/run 3 times total.

Name: Triple Nickel
Description: Start at base, run to opposite end and complete called exercise for 5 reps, run to base and complete exercise for 5 reps, repeating this 5 times. (5/5/5 triple nickel) For an extra challenge perform on a hill

Name: Tuckers
Description: Plank tuck jump to plank jack counting each rep up to 10. So 1 tuck jump, 1 plank jack, then 2 tuck jumps to 2 plank jacks and so on and so on.

Name: Tunnel of Love
Description: Pax Plank side by side some one then crawls under the tunnel of planks. Plank when you reach the end, next pax goes.

Name: Turkish Get up
Description: Laying on back, use only one arm and your legs to "get up" to a standing positing

Name: Twist of the Lion
Description: Hold dumbbells at chest level. With pointed toe, step into a side lunge and twist your torso toward the bent leg, keeping the back leg straight. Return and repeat. (OQ)

Name: Unicycle
Description: Flat on back, bring knees to chest, then legs straight into the air flex feet, then slowly bring legs straight down to the floor but not touching then back to chest. That is one rep.

Name: Up Down Finisher
Description: To the song "Up Down" by Morgan Wallen and Florida Georgia Line. High knees during the verse portion of the song, squats during the chorus when he sings the title of the song. "Going up down - up down - up dooowwn"

Name: V up
Description: Start laying flat, arms above head, perform a sit up while bringing legs straight up to 45 degrees to make a V touching your toes.

Name: VQ
Description: Virgin Q - A Pax first Q. Celebrated and encouraged

Name: Walk Outs
Description: With 2 hand weights. Inchworm out to plank by walking the weights, do a push up and a hip dip for each side. Walk the weights back to your legs and deadlift up.

Name: Walk the Plank
Description: In reverse plank, walk both feet in - forming crab/table top.   Then step both feet back out into rev plank... that's 1 rep. (Toledo South)

Name: Walking Planks
Description: Plank position, move to from side to side  by stepping arms then legs by the number determined by the Q.  Example walking plank 5 step to right and then 5 steps to the left.

Name: Wall Chest Bridges
Description: Lean back against a wall with elbows ~45 degrees from your side.  Press elbows into the wall and squeeze shoulder blades to arch your upper back away from the wall.  Butt should not leave the wall.

Name: Wall Sit
Description: Sitting against a wall with knees bent at a 90 degree angle for a period of time TBD by Q

Name: Wall Walkers
Description: Start with your full body on the ground and the bottom of your feet flat on the wall. Push up into a plank position. Walk both feet up the wall as you walk your hands to the wall. The goal is to touch your nose to the wall without touching your quads to the wall (just toes and nose). Walk your hands back out until you are in plank, then lay back on your belly and start again.

Name: Whack a Mole
Description: Pax circle up an everyone hold a squat.  Go around the circle and each pax complete a squat jump one by one until we get to 25 and when we get to 25 everyone do a burpee.  Start again! Repeat 5x

Name: What Does the Fox Say
Description: Ab routine to the Kidsbop version of What Does the Fox Say. Do Crisscross Applesauce LBCs during the verses and Bicycles during the chorus for the entire duration of the song. PAX will not only complain about the song, but also the ab pain.

Name: Wheel of Push-ups
Description: Grab a piece of curb and perform a set number of incline push ups, staying in plank position rotate 90 degrees clockwise until your body is parallel to the curb with left hand on curb and right hand off- do push ups, rotate 90 degrees again perform decline push ups, rotate again left down right up and do push ups.  Also known as clock push-ups.

Name: Whirlpool
Description: Start standing with both arms straight, extended up in T position at shoulder height. Bend arms at elbows at 90 degrees with hands facing forward. Start by twisting your torso from left to right, in the opposite direction that you are twisting your arms from right to left. Continue to twist arms in opposite direction of torso, then add an upward and downward movement of arms at the shoulders. Move like an agitated washing machine.

Name: White Elephant Gift Exchange
Description:
PAX circle up. In the center of the circle is a box full of “gifts” (slips of paper with various exercises on them–make sure there are at least as many papers as PAX.)
 PAX #1 goes to the center and randomly draws an exercise, goes back to their spot, and starts exercising. PAX 2 can either draw a new exercise or steal the exercise that PAX 1 is doing and start doing that exercise at their spot, forcing PAX 1 back to the center to draw a new gift. PAX 3 can either steal from PAX 1 or 2 or draw a new exercise. Keep on going around the circle until each PAX has drawn an exercise or until all exercises have been drawn. For an extra challenge, target one body part (arms, legs, abs, etc.) per round.

Name: Wide Arm Push-up
Description: Push up with hands more than shoulder width a part

Name: Wild Spiders
Description: Low plank bring right knee to right elbow and back, left knee to left elbow and back, then High plank bring right knee to right elbow and back, left knee to left elbow and back, then push up. Entire combo equals 1 rep.

Name: Windmill
Description: Standing position, feet wider than shoulder width a part, arms straight out. While keeping arms and legs straight touch toes opposite hand to foot. Reaching across the body. Good to use for warm up or stretching at the end.

Name: Windshield Wiper
Description: Laying on back, legs straight in the air, rotate legs to the left then back to center then to right

Name: Wood Chop
Description: Usually done with a weight. Hold one weight, squat down holding weight by the end at your right ankle, then swing weight up with slight bend in elbow up over your left shoulder. Arms should be fully extended at the top. Do one side at a time, then switch to the other side.

Name: World Tours
Description: One (1) Boy Band + 180 degree jump turn (front to back), then one (1) Boy Band + 180 degree jump (back to front).

Name: Wrangler
Description: Stand with arms bent and hands behind head bend at waist to 90 degree angle with leg kept straight, then stand back up and squat keeping hands behind head—bend +squat equals one (Chatt)

Name: X's and O's
Description: On back with leg and arms extended in a X position several inches off the ground, Q calls O Pax pull legs and arms into chest, Q calls X they extend out into the X position.

Name: YAYs
Description: YAYs (You Against You): Squat and tap knees, arms reach high to the left, squat and tap knees, arms reach straight up to the sky, squat and tap knees, arms reach high to the right. Then back to center, left, center, and on.

Name: Zebra Kicks
Description: Downward dog position kick one leg at a time into the air alternating sides. Similar to Donkey kick however on feet not knees

Name: Zora
Description: A Non-Counting Dora Routine. PAX Partner up. One partner gets started on a single exercise while the other partner travels (runs, walks, shuffle, crawl, etc) a set distance.  When the traveling partner returns, partners switch and complete the same exercise. Once that exercise is completed by each partner, move on to a new exercise. Rinse and repeat. Add some fun and laughs by  using animal themed exercises and a choose-your-own animal themed traveler. (Naperville)
